{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"The Meadowbrook State Parkway (also known as the Meadowbrook, the Meadowbrook Parkway or the MSP) is a 12.52 mi parkway in Nassau County, New York, in the United States.","title":"Meadowbrook State Parkway"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" Its southern terminus is at a full cloverleaf interchange with the Bay and Ocean parkways in Jones Beach State Park.","title":"Meadowbrook State Parkway"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" The parkway heads north, crossing South Oyster Bay and intersecting Loop Parkway before crossing onto the mainland and connecting to the Southern State Parkway in North Merrick.","title":"Meadowbrook State Parkway"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" It continues north to the village of Carle Place, where the Meadowbrook Parkway ends at exit 31A of the Northern State Parkway.","title":"Meadowbrook State Parkway"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" The Meadowbrook Parkway is designated New York State Route 908E (NY 908E), an unsigned reference route.","title":"Meadowbrook State Parkway"},{"sentence_id":5,"text":" Most of the road is limited to non-commercial traffic, like most parkways in the state of New York; however, the portion south of Merrick Road is open to commercial traffic.","title":"Meadowbrook State Parkway"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"The Sunken Meadow State Parkway (also known as the Sunken Meadow) is a 6.19 mi long parkway in Suffolk County, Long Island, New York.","title":"Sunken Meadow State Parkway"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" Located entirely within the town of Smithtown, the parkway begins at a cloverleaf interchange with the Northern State Parkway (exits 44–45) and the northern terminus of the Sagtikos State Parkway.","title":"Sunken Meadow State Parkway"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" The parkway, which continues north, is a northern spur of the Sagtikos, which opened in September 1952.","title":"Sunken Meadow State Parkway"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" The northern end of the parkway is at the toll barrier in exit SM5 in the Kings Park section of Smithtown.","title":"Sunken Meadow State Parkway"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" From there, the road continues north through Sunken Meadow State Park to a roundabout at the Long Island Sound.","title":"Sunken Meadow State Parkway"},{"sentence_id":5,"text":" The parkway comprises the northern half of New York State Route 908K (NY 908K, an unsigned reference route), with the Sagtikos State Parkway forming the southern portion.","title":"Sunken Meadow State Parkway"},{"sentence_id":6,"text":" Commercial vehicles are, like on most parkways, prohibited from using the Sunken Meadow, except for a portion north of NY 25A in Kings Park.","title":"Sunken Meadow State Parkway"}],"peer_messages":["Unverified peer answer: noanswer","Unverified peer answer: noanswer"],"previous_answer":"noanswer","question":"What exit of Garden State Parkway should you take in order to get to the Seacourt Pavilion?"}
